metadata.name: apache-8444-cert-switch
metadata.description: 通过 SSH 更新 Apache 证书文件并验证 8444 HTTPS 服务。

targetPlatform.description: 目标平台，当前工作流只允许 Linux。

frameworkType.description: 应用资产框架类型，当前模板固定为 APACHE。

siteName.description: 应用资产站点显示名称。

bindingInformation.description: 应用资产站点绑定信息。

hostHeader.description: HTTPS 验证请求使用的 Host 头。

protocol.description: 应用资产访问协议，当前模板固定使用 HTTPS。

verifyUrl.description: 后端和工作流共同使用的 HTTPS 验证 URL。

apacheSiteConfigPath.description: Apache 8444 站点配置文件路径。

certificateFilePath.description: Apache SSLCertificateFile 证书目的路径。

certificateKeyFilePath.description: Apache SSLCertificateKeyFile 私钥目的路径。

backupRoot.description: 证书备份根目录，实际备份目录为 backupRoot/cert_bak_YYYYMMDD_HHMM。

expectedResponseContains.description: HTTPS 验证响应正文需要包含的文本片段，不要求完整匹配。

serverCert.description: 指定服务器证书产物，必须绑定公钥证书和私钥两个输出项。

certFile.description: 写入 Apache SSLCertificateFile 的证书文件内容。

keyFile.description: 写入 Apache SSLCertificateKeyFile 的私钥文件内容。

steps.name: prepare_linux_target_only
steps.description: 当前工作流只支持 Linux Apache 目标。

steps.name: prepare_apache_framework_only
steps.description: 当前工作流只支持 APACHE 框架类型。

ssh.script:
set -eu
site_conf='{{apacheSiteConfigPath}}'
cert_path='{{certificateFilePath}}'
key_path='{{certificateKeyFilePath}}'
test -f "$site_conf"
grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*SSLCertificateFile[[:space:]]+' "$site_conf"
grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*SSLCertificateKeyFile[[:space:]]+' "$site_conf"
configured_cert="$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SSLCertificateFile[[:space:]]+/ {print $2; exit}' "$site_conf")"
configured_key="$(awk '/^[[:space:]]*SSLCertificateKeyFile[[:space:]]+/ {print $2; exit}' "$site_conf")"
test "$configured_cert" = "$cert_path"
test "$configured_key" = "$key_path"
test -f "$cert_path"
test -f "$key_path"
command -v openssl >/dev/null
apache2ctl -t 2>&1
printf 'TARGET_CERT=%s\n' "$cert_path"
printf 'TARGET_KEY=%s\n' "$key_path"

set -eu
site_conf='{{apacheSiteConfigPath}}'
backup_root='{{backupRoot}}'
current_cert='{{certificateFilePath}}'
current_key='{{certificateKeyFilePath}}'
stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M)"
backup_dir="${backup_root}/cert_bak_${stamp}"
mkdir -p "$backup_dir"
backup_conf="$backup_dir/$(basename "$site_conf")"
backup_cert="$backup_dir/$(basename "$current_cert")"
backup_key="$backup_dir/$(basename "$current_key")"
cp -p "$site_conf" "$backup_conf"
cp -p "$current_cert" "$backup_cert"
cp -p "$current_key" "$backup_key"
old_subject="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
old_issuer="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -issuer | sed 's/^issuer=//')"
old_serial="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')"
old_not_before="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
old_not_after="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
old_fingerprint="$(openssl x509 -in "$current_cert" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | awk -F= '{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d ':')"
printf 'BACKUP_DIR=%s\n' "$backup_dir"
printf 'BACKUP_CONF=%s\n' "$backup_conf"
printf 'BACKUP_CERT=%s\n' "$backup_cert"
printf 'BACKUP_KEY=%s\n' "$backup_key"
printf 'OLD_CERT_PATH=%s\n' "$current_cert"
printf 'OLD_KEY_PATH=%s\n' "$current_key"
printf 'OLD_CERT_SUBJECT=%s\n' "$old_subject"
printf 'OLD_CERT_ISSUER=%s\n' "$old_issuer"
printf 'OLD_CERT_SERIAL=%s\n' "$old_serial"
printf 'OLD_CERT_NOT_BEFORE=%s\n' "$old_not_before"
printf 'OLD_CERT_NOT_AFTER=%s\n' "$old_not_after"
printf 'OLD_CERT_FINGERPRINT=%s\n' "$old_fingerprint"

set -eu
cert_path='{{certificateFilePath}}'
key_path='{{certificateKeyFilePath}}'
cert_pubkey="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -pubkey | openssl pkey -pubin -outform PEM | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
key_pubkey="$(openssl pkey -in "$key_path" -pubout -outform PEM | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$cert_pubkey" = "$key_pubkey"
new_subject="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
new_issuer="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -issuer | sed 's/^issuer=//')"
new_serial="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')"
new_not_before="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
new_not_after="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
new_fingerprint="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | awk -F= '{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d ':')"
apache2ctl -t 2>&1
printf 'NEW_CERT_PATH=%s\n' "$cert_path"
printf 'NEW_KEY_PATH=%s\n' "$key_path"
printf 'NEW_CERT_SUBJECT=%s\n' "$new_subject"
printf 'NEW_CERT_ISSUER=%s\n' "$new_issuer"
printf 'NEW_CERT_SERIAL=%s\n' "$new_serial"
printf 'NEW_CERT_NOT_BEFORE=%s\n' "$new_not_before"
printf 'NEW_CERT_NOT_AFTER=%s\n' "$new_not_after"
printf 'NEW_CERT_FINGERPRINT=%s\n' "$new_fingerprint"

set -eu
apache2ctl -t 2>&1
systemctl reload '{{apacheServiceName}}'
systemctl is-active '{{apacheServiceName}}'
printf 'SERVICE_RELOAD=ok\n'

set -eu
live_cert="$(mktemp)"
echo | openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:{{port}} -servername '{{sniName}}' 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -out "$live_cert"
live_subject="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -subject | sed 's/^subject=//')"
live_issuer="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -issuer | sed 's/^issuer=//')"
live_serial="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -serial | sed 's/^serial=//')"
live_not_before="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -startdate | sed 's/^notBefore=//')"
live_not_after="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -enddate | sed 's/^notAfter=//')"
live_fingerprint="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | awk -F= '{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d ':')"
rm -f "$live_cert"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_SUBJECT=%s\n' "$live_subject"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_ISSUER=%s\n' "$live_issuer"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_SERIAL=%s\n' "$live_serial"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_NOT_BEFORE=%s\n' "$live_not_before"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_NOT_AFTER=%s\n' "$live_not_after"
printf 'LIVE_CERT_FINGERPRINT=%s\n' "$live_fingerprint"
printf 'CERT_COMPARE_OLD=%s\n' '{{oldCertificateFingerprintSha256}}'
printf 'CERT_COMPARE_NEW=%s\n' "$live_fingerprint"

steps.name: verify_show_certificate_comparison
steps.instruction: {{siteName}} 证书替换完成。站点绑定：{{bindingInformation}}。备份目录：{{backupDirectory}}。后端 HTTPS 验证状态：{{backendHttpStatus}}。替换前证书：subject={{oldCertificateSubject}}；issuer={{oldCertificateIssuer}}；serial={{oldCertificateSerial}}；notBefore={{oldCertificateNotBefore}}；notAfter={{oldCertificateNotAfter}}；sha256={{oldCertificateFingerprintSha256}}。替换后证书：subject={{liveCertificateSubject}}；issuer={{liveCertificateIssuer}}；serial={{liveCertificateSerial}}；notBefore={{liveCertificateNotBefore}}；notAfter={{liveCertificateNotAfter}}；sha256={{liveCertificateFingerprintSha256}}。

ssh.script:
set -eu
site_conf='{{apacheSiteConfigPath}}'
cert_path='{{certificateFilePath}}'
key_path='{{certificateKeyFilePath}}'
cp -p '{{backupConfigPath}}' "$site_conf"
cp -p '{{backupCertificateFile}}' "$cert_path"
cp -p '{{backupCertificateKeyFile}}' "$key_path"
restored_fingerprint="$(openssl x509 -in "$cert_path" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | awk -F= '{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d ':')"
test "$restored_fingerprint" = '{{oldCertificateFingerprintSha256}}'
apache2ctl -t 2>&1
printf 'ROLLBACK_RESTORE_FINGERPRINT=%s\n' "$restored_fingerprint"
printf 'ROLLBACK_RESTORE=ok\n'

set -eu
systemctl reload '{{apacheServiceName}}'
systemctl is-active '{{apacheServiceName}}'
live_cert="$(mktemp)"
echo | openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:{{port}} -servername '{{sniName}}' 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -out "$live_cert"
live_fingerprint="$(openssl x509 -in "$live_cert" -noout -fingerprint -sha256 | awk -F= '{print tolower($2)}' | tr -d ':')"
rm -f "$live_cert"
test "$live_fingerprint" = '{{oldCertificateFingerprintSha256}}'
printf 'ROLLBACK_LIVE_FINGERPRINT=%s\n' "$live_fingerprint"
printf 'ROLLBACK_RELOAD=ok\n'
